details.biography:
Jacob's Well · Seat 2, Healer

Ilmater is the god of those who suffer through the long winter, and you go where the suffering is. The Keepers pay a field priest's wage. You have set bones in blizzards before and you are quietly proud of it.

Tonight: Someone upstairs is very ill. Nobody will let you see him.
details.backgroundStory:
Abilities (from the printed sheet)

Spellcasting. Wisdom. Spell save DC 14. Slots: 4 cantrips, three 1st, two 2nd. Prepare 6 spells each morning from the whole Cleric list. See the spell page.

Turn Undead. 6 times a day, as an action: undead within 30ft that can see or hear you make a Will save (DC 14) or flee and stay beyond 30ft for 1 minute.

Ilmater's Favour. Advantage on First Aid/Healing checks. Once a day: heal a creature 2d8+3 HP. Favoured weapon: cestus.

Healer (feat, 1st). Healing spells and brewed potions restore +1 HP per die. Once a day, cast a healing spell of 3rd level or lower without spending a slot.

Dwarf. Speed never reduced by armour or encumbrance. Advantage on stonework checks. Stonebraced: once per long rest, treat a critical hit against you as a normal hit, or ignore a knockdown. Advantage on Brewing checks (chosen craft). Clan weapon: your grandmother's war hammer.

Casting

Other good picks tonight: Shield of Faith, Protection from Alignment, Detect Secret Doors (1st); Silence, Hold Person, Lesser Restoration (2nd).

Armour Class on the sheet: Scale mail +4, steel shield +1

Class Abilities

1st Level

Spell Use

  • Effect: Cast divine spells per the Spells Per Day table. Bonus slots from high Wisdom (see Spellcasting in Arneyan, II).

Turn Undead

  • Effect: As an action, up to 3 + your Wisdom modifier times per day, present your holy symbol — every undead within 30ft that can see or hear you rolls a Will save.
  • Turn DC = 10 + half your Cleric level (rounded down, minimum 1) + Wisdom modifier
  • Below 8th level: failed save = turned — undead flees and cannot approach within 30ft for 1 minute
  • 8th level and above: failed save = destroyed outright if its Level is no more than half your Cleric level, otherwise turned
  • Evil Clerics may turn OR control undead under the same DC — controlling requires your Cleric level to be 5 or more above the undead's Level. Controlled undead obey for 1 hour per Cleric level, and you can control at most your Cleric level in total Levels of undead at once

Weapon Selection

  • Effect: Full Cleric weapon list usable without disadvantage. Faith additionally grants automatic training in the deity's specific favoured weapon, even if it falls outside the standard list.

Battle Priest

  • Effect: If your deity is a war god (Torm, Helm, Tyr, Drake, Moradin, Gruumsh, Maglubiyet, Bane, Zindel of Mournas or Daeric Khyrmin), you can become a Battle Priest when you take your first Cleric level.
  • The choice is permanent.
  • You use the Knight Base to Hit track (the Paladin's: +7 at 12th, +15 at 24th) instead of the Cleric's, you gain Extra Attack at 7th level, and your spell slots come from the Spells Per Day row two below your Cleric level (none at 1st or 2nd level).
  • Cantrips, Turn Undead and your deity's granted power are unchanged.
  • A Battle Priest needs 12 XP per level, like the Paladin, instead of the Cleric's 10.

3rd Level

  • Perfect Recall: recall a previously cast 1st-level spell once per day via a Wisdom check (DC 10, the Easy tier), casting it again without expending a slot; from 13th level it also works for previously cast 2nd-level spells

5th Level

Banish

  • Effect: Your Turn Undead also works on fiends and other extraplanar creatures, as if you were a Cleric 4 levels lower. A fiend or other extraplanar creature that fails is driven back to its own plane if its Level is no more than half your Cleric level; otherwise it is turned.

7th Level

  • Extra Attack (Battle Priest only): When you use your action to attack, make one additional weapon attack as part of it, with Disadvantage (see Extra attacks in The Arneyan Codex).

9th Level

Divine Monolith

  • Effect: A permanent 10ft aura of divine power that cannot be dispelled. You and your allies within it gain +1 to saves, and your Turn Undead DC rises by 1.

15th Level

  • Wisdom Bonus: permanent +1 Wisdom

18th Level

Holy Campaign

  • Effect: Once per year, or once per campaign at the GM's call, raise 1–100 NPCs with d8 HD plus 1–100 NPCs with d4 HD. All gain +1 on checks while the Cleric is present.
  • Scales at 19th: 2–200 / 2–200 NPCs, bonus increases to +2
  • Scales at 23rd: 4–400 / 4–400 NPCs, bonus increases to +3, gains 1st/2nd/3rd level leaders per 20 troops

21st Level

Banish (Improved)

  • Effect: Banish now works at your full level and reaches the greatest outsiders:
  • Banishes for 21+ days
  • Affects 1d12 minor demons or devils
  • Affects 1d6 major demons or devils
  • Affects 1 demon lord or arch devil

22nd Level

Divine Monolith (Improved)

  • Effect: The aura grows to 20ft and its power deepens:
  • All creatures within the aura are immune to death attacks
  • +3 to the Turn Undead DC (instead of +1)
  • All creatures within the aura, you included, gain +2 to attribute checks and saves (instead of +1 to saves)

23rd Level

Mark of the Saint

  • Effect: Recognised as a saint regardless of alignment.
  • Gains 1d10 followers per Wisdom point
  • Grants weekly: Heal, Remove Blindness or Deafness, Remove Disease
  • Grants daily: Holy or Unholy Word
  • Grants weekly: Resurrection

Deities and Kits

Each kit is an item in the Kits compendium, in the Cleric folder. Drag one onto your character.

  • The Cleric's kit is their deity.
  • Choose one at character creation.
  • Your deity grants a favoured weapon (automatic training even outside the standard list) and a unique granted power, and you follow its tenets (see Divine Favour in Book II).
  • The archdevils and demon lords not listed here (every one but Asmodeus and Lolth) serve only as Warlock patrons.
